central_theme: Freedom, wit, solidarity, strategic thinking, and avian conservation

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: The innate human and animal desire for freedom above material luxury.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Intelligence and collective wisdom can overcome physical bondage and power.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Value liberty over comfort; clever strategies succeed where force fails.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: A wealthy merchant keeps a caged talking parrot; prepares to travel to its homeland.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Merchant meets wild parrots; when he conveys greetings, a wild bird feigns death and falls.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: Merchant returns and narrates this; the caged parrot understands the code and plays dead.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: Merchant sorrowfully places 'dead' bird on window sill; bird instantly flies to freedom.

child_nodes.title: The Caged Parrot
child_nodes.details: Intelligent, observant bird that seeks freedom over golden comfort.

child_nodes.title: The Merchant
child_nodes.details: Rich, well-meaning owner who unknowingly passes the secret escape strategy.

child_nodes.title: The Wild Parrots
child_nodes.details: Wise jungle flock that communicates a silent message of liberation.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Merchant, feigned, sorrowfully, motionless, captivity, flock, strategy.

child_nodes.title: Adverbs of Manner
child_nodes.details: Describing actions: sorrowfully laid, silently watched, joyfully flew.

child_nodes.title: Direct & Indirect Speech
child_nodes.details: Reporting greetings and news between merchant and parrots.

child_nodes.title: Wildlife Integration
child_nodes.details: Informational focus on Indian bird sanctuaries (Bharatpur, Ranganathittu).
